UI fixer (makes the strict suite green again): GeoUI must react to the new stop event baseSpotted {baseId, missionId, etaS}. Add it to GeoUI.model.REACT as a popup with terror tone and the siren, plus the i18n key geo.ev.baseSpotted (title and body). Example: «Os alienígenas localizaram a base {base} — ataque iminente (não antes de {eta})», where eta is formatted from etaS seconds and is at least 24 h. The baseDefence popup then reports the ground result (shots = the single defence volley).

from_playtest: Pacing, js/data/ufos.js (data owner): the cannon counter never brings down a Small Scout at Veterano. It escapes after breakOff 200 + RNG(0,200) − 30·coef = 140–340 ticks (4–10 s), while the approach to cannon range takes ~5 s. Suggested patch: small_scout `breakOff: 200` → `breakOff: 360` (300–660 ticks, about 9–20 s). That makes «switch the Stingray off to get a crash site» viable, as DESIGN §14 and the dogfight UI hint promise.

Pacing, council (sim/data owner): every January run ended «Terrível», about −1 076. Two terror sites expire at −1 000 each (Kinshasa or Vancouver, then a second one), while a won crash mission earns about +100. On Veterano a second bad month ends the game on 1 March, so a new player who misses one terror site in February loses after about 60 days, far short of the 2–4 h arc. Options (CAMPAIGN_API §8 knobs): `scoring.terrorSiteExpired` −1000 → −500 for months 0–1, or `TERROR_SITE_HOURS` [8,16] → [12,24].

Battle difficulty (battle/data owner): a Large Scout (6 Sectoids) as the first crash at Veterano was lost 0/2 by the scripted squad. The squad was wiped and the Skyranger lost, which effectively ends the campaign in January. Consider capping the month-0 crash crew or the Large Scout deployment rows for difficulty ≥ 1.

Battle performance (battle owner): even with Space held to fast-forward, alien turns 8–10 on the 40×40 forest Large Scout map took 15–35 s in this shared, CPU-loaded container. Small/Medium Scout maps took 2–7 s.

Contract tidy-up (architect, docs/CAMPAIGN_API.md §6.2/§6.3): note that a Geoscape scene created when G.t > 0 opens paused at the 5-s speed, and that CampaignUI.afterBattle deletes the 'autoTurn' slot.

Data note: Portugal is not a funding country, so the default Lisbon base shows «Fora dos países financiadores…» on the very first decision for a pt-PT audience. Consider it when tuning js/data/geo.js countries; no change made.

Minor, my area, left as is: the Geoscape craft card keeps showing the pre-dogfight hull and fuel while the dogfight overlay is on top, because the geoscape does not think under it. It refreshes once the overlay closes.
Minor, my area, left as is: toasts that fire while the monthly report is open now sit above its footer and can briefly cover the last rows of the funding table.
Globe (globe_render.js, not touched): I found no globe bugs in these runs. The frame rate cannot be judged in this GPU-less container, so ≥ 50 fps while rotating still needs checking on a real Mac.
